issue.subject: OLT, PON and line-quality faults are routed to NOC with the findings
issue.description:
NOC-AUTO S5

**Statement:** As a NOC engineer, I need a ticket with an OLT outage, PON-side error or line-profile problem routed to NOC with the findings in the comment, so that I start from the diagnosis instead of re-checking the network.

**PRD:** https://rnd.frontiir.net/en/products/rt/requirements/noc-ticket-automation-prd

**ACs (6):**

- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC12` OLT offline: When the OLT is offline the ticket moves to NOC with the OLT-offline fields, status and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC15` ONU on/off: When the 3-day average ONU on/off count exceeds 20 the ticket moves to NOC with the matching fields and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC16` Port loss: When the 3-day average port-loss count exceeds 20 the ticket moves to NOC with the matching fields and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC17` BIP8 errors: When the 3-day average BIP8 error count exceeds 20 the ticket moves to NOC with the matching fields and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC18` Line profile mismatch: When the line profile is NO_INTERNET, SUSPEND, MN_Default_3.00Mbps, blank or N/A the ticket moves to NOC with the matching fields and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC19` EPC outage: When the ONU is not working and was last seen under 12 hours ago the ticket moves to NOC with the matching fields and comment.

**Open points:**

- AC18: Value list decided 2026-11-18 and matches #21503. Match type (case, whitespace, null as blank) still open.

**Implementation status:** code exists on the feature branch, unvalidated. Tasks to be refined by Dev after the Story is agreed.

**Related (reference only):** #21613, #22265
